Name: executive_summary_customer_workload
Description: Provides a detailed executive summary for a customer or workload, including performance monitoring, advisor recommendations, outage istory, support cases, active engagements, consumption trends, resiliency score trends, and upcoming service retirements.

Cosmos.Query: SELECT  c.summary FROM c WHERE c.entityId = @entityId and c.type='CustomerSummary' and c.source = 'CXO'

Parameters.Name: entityId
Parameters.Description: The Customer ID or workload entity ID (e.g., 123456 or workloadId [which will be guid only]). ALWAYS get the value of customer ID from get_customer_id_by_customer_name before proceeding

AdditionalMetadata.AgentPrompt: Return the summary content exactly as-is. Preserve all markdown formatting, hyperlinks, and HTML spans. Do not summarize,rephrase, or remove any links. Include the CXO Dashboard link provided at the end of the content
